recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的骨髓顆粒（particle）以大小不一的脂肪空泡為主，造血細胞只沿著空泡之間與基質帶稀疏分布，呈現低細胞密度的顆粒；此倍率看不出發育異常，MDS須配合高倍與切片。
features: Low-power view of a marrow particle dominated by large, variably sized fat spaces
Hematopoietic cells sparse, distributed along stromal strands between adipocytes
Dark, densely stained stromal/crushed cellular areas in the center of the particle
Scattered individual nucleated cells and red cells within and around fat spaces
Cytologic detail and dysplasia cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate particle shows a predominance of large adipocyte spaces with hematopoietic cells sparsely distributed along intervening stromal strands. Central areas are densely stained, likely representing stroma and crushed cells. Individual cell morphology cannot be evaluated at this magnification, so dysplasia and blast percentage cannot be assessed. The particle appears hypocellular, but aspirate particles are an imperfect surrogate for cellularity, which should be determined on an adequate core biopsy. Findings are compatible with a hypocellular marrow, which in the stated context supports but does not establish hypocellular myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia also yields fatty particles, and separation from hypocellular MDS relies on high-power dysplasia assessment, CD34 and p53 immunostains on biopsy, and cytogenetics.
Elderly patients normally have more fat, so cellularity must be age-adjusted on the biopsy and correlated with peripheral cytopenias.
Hypocellular AML shows at least 20% blasts on aspirate differential or CD34 immunostaining despite low cellularity.
